title: Creamy Italian Pudding
description: A rich and creamy dessert inspired by Italian flavors, perfect for warm weather. This pudding is light and refreshing, with a hint of sweetness.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together the milk, sugar, and cocoa powder.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the mixture comes to a simmer.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm milk mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Return the saucepan to medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the outstandingly rich Italian cream.
Strain the pudding into individual serving cups and chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Serve chilled, garnished with whipped cream and a sprinkle of cocoa powder if desired.
